title: Antigravity History Fix
subtitle: A visual assistant to apply, verify and revert Antigravity fixes.
welcome_text: This assistant keeps maintenance simple for beginners while still giving technical users clear control.
how_text: The assistant locates the Antigravity installation, checks the supported version and applies only the fixes you choose. Each modified file gets a backup so changes can be reverted.
terms_text: We do not collect, store, sell or transmit your personal data. The assistant operates locally on your computer. Applying a fix can modify Antigravity files and creates backups so the changes can be restored.
agree: I have read and agree to the terms
auto_run_desc: Makes the “Always Proceed” terminal policy execute automatically when supported.
link_approval_desc: Removes the confirmation step for opening external links.
uninstall_text: Restores files from available backups and removes changes made by the patches.
restart: Restart Antigravity for the changes to take effect.
thanks: Thank you for using the project!
thanks_text: If this project helped, follow the development and share it with others.
cancel_confirm: Do you want to cancel and close the wizard?
windows: Windows is supported. The default Antigravity path is detected automatically.
